_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Nang {player_id} kaw Liar's Dice kaw shi kaw mi {num_players} kaw shi kaw mi hta.
Taw dan:
- Nang hta na kaw, nang hta na:
  1) Shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta [Bid: 3, 4] taw,
  2) Shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta '[Call]' taw.

Nang [Call] taw:
  - Shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw na kaw re kaw hta kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw, shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw.
  - Shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw na kaw re kaw hta kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw, nang hta kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw.
Shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw kaw 0 hta na kaw re kaw hta kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw, shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw kaw.

board.new_round:
New round - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Nang ai hpe dice {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! Actual count of face {face_value} {count}, sha ai LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (last bidder) hkrang one die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! Actual count of face {face_value} {count}, sha ai >= {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (caller) hkrang one die.
